relationships.subject: Noradrenaline
relationships.evidence_quote: These experiments indicate that sensory nerves in the soleus muscles that receive a gravity stimulus activate the sympathetic pathway at the L5 level, resulting in the production of noradrenaline, which upregulates CCL20 expression at the L5 dorsal vessels

relationships.subject: Atenolol
relationships.evidence_quote: treatment with the norepinephrine antagonist atenolol significantly suppressed CCL20 mRNA expression, NFκB activation, and pathogenic CD4+ T cell accumulation around the L5 vessels and abrogated EAE development

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: To confirm this hypothesis, pain stimulation was performed in TRPV1 knockout mice, but no relapse was observed.

relationships.subject: Noradrenaline
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that MHC2+CD11b+ cells increased the expression of CX3CR1 and its ligand CX3CL1 from L5 vessels in response to sympathetic noradrenaline.

relationships.subject: Pathogenic CD4+ T cells
relationships.evidence_quote: After pathogenic CD4+ T cell accumulates, the BBB is breached due to various cytokines including NFκB and STAT stimulators from pathogenic CD4+ T cells

key_findings: Gateway reflex: sensory-sympathetic neural circuits (gravity, pain, stress, light) drive noradrenaline-NFkB-chemokine expression at specific vessels, letting autoreactive CD4+ T cells breach blood barriers.
Pain-induced EAE relapse requires TRPV1+ sensory nerves and sympathetic signaling (CX3CL1), with ACC activation proposed.
